title: Ukrainian Air Defense Forces Intercept 102 Enemy UAVs Overnight
summary: Ukrainian air defense forces intercepted and suppressed 102 enemy unmanned aerial vehicles overnight on May 23, including Shahed-type, Gerbera, and Italmas drones launched from multiple Russian directions. The attack continues with additional drone groups in Ukrainian airspace.
contents:
## Ukrainian Air Defense Intercepts 102 Enemy UAVs

### Attack Overview
During the night of May 23 (from 18:30 on May 22), Russian forces launched 124 strike UAVs including Shahed-type (both jet-powered variants), Gerbera, Italmas, and decoy drones designated as "Parody" from multiple launch points across Russian territory and occupied Crimea.

### Launch Directions
The enemy launched drones from the following directions:
- Kursk, Russia
- Shatalovo, Russia
- Bryansk, Russia
- Millerovo, Russia
- Primorsko-Akhtarsk, Russia
- Hvardiiske, temporarily occupied Crimea

### Defense Response
Ukrainian aviation, anti-aircraft missile forces, electronic warfare units, unmanned systems units, and mobile fire groups of the Defense Forces all participated in repelling the aerial attack.

### Results
As of 08:30 local time, Ukrainian air defense forces had shot down or suppressed 102 enemy UAVs of Shahed, Gerbera, Italmas, and other types across the northern, southern, and eastern regions of the country.

### Impact Assessment
Authorities confirmed that 12 strike UAVs hit targets across 9 locations, while debris from intercepted drones fell at 5 additional locations. The General Staff warned that the attack remained ongoing, with several groups of enemy UAVs still operating in Ukrainian airspace, and urged citizens to follow safety protocols.

title: Kataib Hezbollah Figure Allegedly Plotted Assassination of Ivanka Trump in Retaliation for Soleimani Killing
summary: The New York Post reported that Mohammed Baqir al-Saadi, a senior figure in the Iran-backed Iraqi militia Kataib Hezbollah who recently faced arrest and indictment in the US, allegedly planned to assassinate Ivanka Trump in retaliation for the 2020 killing of IRGC Quds Force commander Qasem Soleimani.
contents:
## Kataib Hezbollah Figure Indicted Over Alleged Ivanka Trump Assassination Plot

### Background
According to a report by the New York Post, Mohammed Baqir al-Saadi, a senior figure in the Iran-backed Iraqi militia Kataib Hezbollah, recently faced arrest and indictment in the United States. The charges include an alleged plot to assassinate Ivanka Trump, daughter of US President Donald Trump.

### Alleged Motive
The reported assassination plan emerged as retaliation for the January 2020 US drone strike that killed Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) Quds Force commander Qasem Soleimani at Baghdad International Airport. The Soleimani killing triggered widespread anger among Iran-aligned militia groups across Iraq and the broader Middle East.

### Evidence Cited
The report claims al-Saadi possessed a blueprint of Ivanka Trump's Florida residence, which she shares with her husband Jared Kushner. Additionally, he allegedly posted a map online showing the area of her Florida home along with Arabic-language threats stating that "neither your palaces nor the Secret Service will protect you."

### Significance
The indictment highlights the persistent threat posed by Iran-backed militias against US officials and their families. Kataib Hezbollah has operated as one of the most prominent Iran-aligned paramilitary groups in Iraq, maintaining close ties with the IRGC and engaging in attacks against US forces stationed in the region.

### Context
The revelation comes amid heightened tensions between the United States and Iran, with the ongoing conflict and ceasefire negotiations dominating the geopolitical landscape in the Middle East.

title: US Navy MH-60S Helicopter Spotted Over Gulf of Oman With RESCU11 Callsign
summary: MenchOsint reported a US Navy MH-60S helicopter operating over the Gulf of Oman under the callsign RESCU11, potentially conducting a rescue mission from a warship deployed in the Arabian Sea.
contents:
## US Navy Helicopter Activity Over Gulf of Oman

### Sighting Details

MenchOsint identified a US Navy MH-60S helicopter operating over the Gulf of Oman using the callsign RESCU11 on May 23, 2026. The analyst noted this helicopter belongs to one of the warships currently deployed in the Arabian Sea as part of ongoing US naval operations in the region.

### Operational Context

The RESCU11 callsign suggests a search-and-rescue mission profile. The MH-60S Sea Hawk helicopter serves as the US Navy's primary platform for combat logistics, search and rescue, and special warfare support. Multiple US Navy warships currently operate in the Arabian Sea and Gulf of Oman region as part of the broader US Central Command naval presence enforcing the ongoing blockade of Iranian ports.

### Strategic Significance

The Gulf of Oman remains a critical maritime corridor connecting the Arabian Sea to the Strait of Hormuz. US naval aviation activity in this area reflects the sustained American military presence maintaining pressure on Iran during the ongoing ceasefire and diplomatic negotiations. The helicopter's assignment to an Arabian Sea warship indicates continued high-tempo operations by US naval forces in the CENTCOM area of responsibility, where two carrier strike groups and numerous surface combatants continue operating.

title: Aircraft Tracked Landing in Muscat Amid Heightened Gulf Regional Activity
summary: MenchOsint tracked an aircraft landing in Muscat, Oman, during a period of intense diplomatic and military activity in the Gulf region amid US-Iran negotiations.
contents:
## Aircraft Landing Tracked in Muscat

### Flight Tracking Report

MenchOsint reported tracking an aircraft that landed in Muscat, the capital of Oman, on May 23, 2026. The open-source intelligence analyst shared flight tracking data indicating the arrival, though specific aircraft identification details remained limited in the initial report.

### Regional Context

Muscat serves as a strategically important aviation hub in the Gulf of Oman region. Oman has historically played a mediating role in regional conflicts, including facilitating back-channel communications between the United States and Iran. The aircraft landing occurred during an especially active period of diplomatic shuttle missions, with Pakistan's military chief Field Marshal Asim Munir visiting Tehran and Qatari negotiators also arriving in the Iranian capital to help broker a deal to end the US-Iran conflict.

### Monitoring Significance

Flight tracking in the Gulf region has taken on heightened importance as military and diplomatic flights crisscross the area. The US maintains significant naval and air assets throughout the Gulf of Oman and Arabian Sea, while regional capitals host frequent high-level diplomatic delegations attempting to mediate the ongoing crisis. Oman's Muscat International Airport regularly handles both commercial and military traffic transiting the region.

title: Ukraine Marks Heroes Day Honoring Defenders Across All Eras
summary: The Main Intelligence Directorate of Ukraine's Ministry of Defence published a commemorative statement for Heroes Day on May 23, honoring Ukrainian warriors from ancient Kyivan Rus through the current Russian-Ukrainian war.
contents:
## Ukraine Commemorates Heroes Day on May 23

### Overview
The Main Intelligence Directorate (GUR) of Ukraine's Ministry of Defence released an official commemorative statement marking Heroes Day, a national observance honoring Ukrainian fighters and defenders throughout history.

### Historical Scope
The statement traces a continuous lineage of Ukrainian heroism spanning centuries — from warriors of the Kyivan Rus princely era to Cossack knights, from Haidamaky and Opryshky fighters to Sich Riflemen, from soldiers of the Ukrainian People's Republic Army to underground liberation movement fighters, from Heroes of the Heavenly Hundred to combatants in the current Russian-Ukrainian war.

The GUR statement emphasized that multiple attempts have targeted the interruption of Ukrainian history through decrees, exile, famine, executions, and occupations, yet individuals consistently took upon themselves the sacred duty to endure, fight, and defend.

### Named Historical Figures
The statement referenced numerous Ukrainian national heroes including Princess Olga, Sviatoslav the Brave, Volodymyr the Great, Yaroslav the Wise, Ostrozky, Sahaidachny, Khmelnytsky, Bohun, Mazepa, Orlyk, Skoropadsky, Petliura, Bolbochan, Konovalets, Melnyk, and Shukhevych, among thousands of other prominent leaders, military commanders, and statesmen.

### Current Generation
The directorate highlighted that the current generation — those who now destroy Russian aggression, conduct reconnaissance, launch assaults, rescue the wounded, and liberate and defend cities and villages — has continued and advanced the cause of their predecessors: building a free, successful European state.

The statement concluded with a call to honor all fighters for Ukraine and the rights of its people across all eras, and all warriors who fell for freedom and dignity in battle.

title: Trump Administration Prepares Possible New Military Strikes on Iran Amid Ongoing Talks
summary: The Trump administration has begun preparing for potential new military strikes against Iran while diplomatic negotiations continue. U.S. officials have started canceling military leave and updating readiness plans amid concerns over possible Iranian retaliation.
contents:
## U.S. Military Readiness Escalation Against Iran

### Preparations Underway
The Trump administration has launched preparations for possible new military strikes against Iran, even as indirect diplomatic negotiations continue through intermediaries. According to CBS News reporting cited by Clash Report, U.S. military and intelligence officials have already begun canceling leave, updating emergency deployment plans, and preparing overseas bases for potential operations.

### Diplomatic Parallel Track
The preparations proceed alongside ongoing diplomatic talks, indicating that Washington maintains dual-track engagement with Tehran. No final decision on strikes has materialized, but the readiness posture signals growing concern within the administration about the trajectory of negotiations.

### Retaliation Concerns
Senior defense officials have expressed heightened concern about possible Iranian retaliation should military operations resume. The cancellation of military leave and updating of deployment plans suggest the Pentagon anticipates a potential escalation cycle that could extend beyond initial strike operations.

### Strategic Context
This development follows months of tensions between Washington and Tehran, with the Strait of Hormuz remaining a critical flashpoint in the broader U.S.-Iran confrontation. The dual approach of military preparation and diplomatic engagement reflects the administration's strategy of maintaining maximum pressure while leaving negotiation channels open.

title: IRGC-Linked Iraqi Suspect Allegedly Plotted Assassination of Ivanka Trump Over Soleimani Killing
summary: An IRGC-linked Iraqi suspect, Mohammad Baqer Al-Saadi, allegedly plotted to assassinate Ivanka Trump in revenge for the 2020 killing of Qasem Soleimani. Authorities reported he possessed maps of her Florida residence and had threatened the Trump family online.
contents:
## Alleged IRGC-Linked Assassination Plot

### Suspect and Allegations
Authorities have identified Mohammad Baqer Al-Saadi, an Iraqi national with alleged links to Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC), as the suspect behind a plot to assassinate Ivanka Trump. According to reporting from the New York Post cited by Clash Report, Al-Saadi allegedly sought revenge for the January 2020 U.S. drone strike that killed IRGC Quds Force commander Qasem Soleimani.

### Evidence Discovered
Investigators found that Al-Saadi possessed detailed maps of Ivanka Trump's Florida residence and had made threats against the Trump family through online channels. The discovery of these materials prompted law enforcement action against the suspect.

### Connection to Soleimani Strike
The alleged plot directly connects to the January 3, 2020 U.S. drone strike at Baghdad International Airport that killed Soleimani, the head of the IRGC's elite Quds Force. Tehran vowed retaliation following the strike, and multiple plots targeting U.S. officials have surfaced in subsequent years.

### Broader Pattern
This case fits within a broader pattern of IRGC-linked plots targeting current and former U.S. officials, highlighting the persistent security threat posed by Iranian-backed networks operating internationally. The targeting of a family member rather than an official directly involved in the Soleimani operation underscores the indiscriminate nature of these revenge-motivated plots.

title: Hezbollah Explosive Drone Strikes Kiryat Shmona Settlement in Northern Israel
summary: The Israeli occupation army reported that an explosive-laden drone launched by Hezbollah crashed in the settlement of Kiryat Shmona in northern occupied Palestine. The incident highlights continued cross-border tensions between Hezbollah and Israel.
contents:
## Hezbollah Drone Attack on Kiryat Shmona

### Incident Details
The Israeli military confirmed that an explosive-laden drone launched by Hezbollah crashed in the settlement of Kiryat Shmona, located in northern Israel near the Lebanese border. The drone struck the settlement area, according to a statement from the Israeli occupation army reported by Quds News Network.

### Strategic Location
Kiryat Shmona sits approximately 3 kilometers south of the Lebanese border, making it a frequent target of Hezbollah operations. The city has experienced repeated rocket and drone attacks throughout the ongoing regional conflict, and its proximity to the border places it within range of various Hezbollah launch systems.

### Escalation Pattern
This drone strike continues the pattern of Hezbollah cross-border operations targeting northern Israeli settlements and military positions. The use of explosive-laden drones has become an increasingly common tactic, presenting challenges for Israeli air defense systems designed primarily to intercept rockets and missiles.

### Regional Context
The attack occurs amid heightened tensions across the Middle East, with the broader U.S.-Iran confrontation and ongoing Gaza operations creating multiple pressure points. Hezbollah has maintained its campaign of strikes against northern Israel as part of what it describes as a support front for Palestinian resistance in Gaza.

title: Israeli Settlers Under Army Cover Assault Palestinian Family and Steal Equipment in Masafer Yatta
summary: Israeli settlers, protected by army forces, assaulted a Palestinian family harvesting their land in Khirbet Al-Manezel area in Masafer Yatta, south of Hebron, and stole their agricultural equipment according to local sources and witnesses.
contents:
## Settler Attack on Palestinian Farmers in Masafer Yatta

### Incident Overview
Israeli settlers, operating under the protection of Israeli army forces, attacked a Palestinian family during their morning harvest in the Khirbet Al-Manezel area of Masafer Yatta, south of occupied Hebron. Local sources and witnesses confirmed that the settlers physically assaulted the family members and seized their agricultural equipment.

### Location and Context
Masafer Yatta, a collection of Palestinian communities in the South Hebron Hills, has faced persistent settler violence and military operations aimed at displacing its residents. The area has drawn international attention due to an Israeli High Court ruling that allowed the military to declare parts of the region a firing zone, threatening the homes and livelihoods of approximately 1,000 Palestinian residents.

### Pattern of Violence
The incident follows a well-documented pattern of settler attacks on Palestinian agricultural activities in the occupied West Bank. Settlers frequently target farmers during olive harvesting and crop seasons, often with the tacit or active support of Israeli military forces present in the area.

### Theft of Equipment
The confiscation of agricultural equipment compounds the economic impact on the affected family, as farming tools represent a significant investment for rural Palestinian communities. Such thefts effectively prevent families from continuing their agricultural work, serving as an additional mechanism of displacement pressure.
